messages:
anna: FYI intake arrived this morning. Assessors flagged RBAC over-permission and missing audit slices; they want a limited retest focused on KMS decrypt scope and log exports.
diego: Can we do an automated ephemeral role for them? Prefer terraform module so infra can revoke quickly.
priya: Yes. We'll create an assessor-specific KMS alias and a grant constrained by EncryptionContext. Only Decrypt for `audit/exports/*`. Grant TTL = 48h.
sec-bot: Reminder: any KMS grant change must include `pt:grant=true` tag on the ticket. Approval required from SecLead.
anna: Evidence packaging: gzipped CloudTrail + application audit files, presigned URLs with 5d expiry, and a checksums.txt with sha256 sums. No plaintext keys shared.
diego: I'll script the session policy to restrict S3 prefixes and require MFA for assume-role. Also log the grant creation so CloudTrail shows it.
priya: Legal requested a signed NDA addendum before links go out. Please attach to the ticket.
ops-scheduler: Tentative retest slots: Thu 10:00-11:30 PT primary, Fri 15:00-16:30 PT fallback. I'll post invites after ticket is created.
anna: Who owns the ticket? Need one tracker for PR -> KMS grant -> exports -> handoff -> retest -> retest verification.
diego: I'll create the ticket and include a dry-run checklist. Tagging @priya and @ops-scheduler.
priya: I'll prepare export scripts and checksum generator.
sec-bot: Automated checks will verify `pt:grant=true` on ticket creation and that NDA PDF is attached before access is allowed.
anna: Thanks. Action items assigned; confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:
messages_summary: Assign owners, create ephemeral KMS grant scoped to audit exports, require NDA before evidence links, schedule retest slots
